scope: Proposition 7.1 (Even coefficient system) of the manuscript “A pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves with rational two-torsion” (preprints/A-pointwise-2-converse-for-elliptic-curves-with-rational-two-torsion-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 004 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df42f33f68fbef77), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an even-sign filter and a nonvanishing index D0 in it. There is a holomorphic cuspidal form g = ∑︁ n≥1 a(n)qn of weight 3/2, orthogonal to unary theta series, of level supported on a fixed enlargement of S, and characters η, ψ of 2-power order such that ψ/η = χ−σ and a(p2 n) = (︁ η(p)ap(E) − ψ(p)(−n/p) )︁ a(n) − pη(p)2 a(n/p2 ) (p / ∈ S). (7.1) Its coefficients are zero off the unit-squareclass filter. After normalization at D0, every squarefree coefficient is rational up to a 2-power root of unity. For two nonzero squarefree coefficients, 2v (︃ a(D) a(D0) )︃ = v (︃ L∗(σD) L∗(σD0) )︃ . (7.2) Moreover a(D) ̸= 0 exactly when L(E(σD), 1) ̸= 0. Consequently any previously established bound v(L∗(σD)) ≥ 2w(D) + s(σD) − C gives v(a(D)) ≥ w(D) + 1 2s(σD) − Cg (7.3) with Cg fixed independently of D.
